name: Unwelcome Spirits

angles.text: For those who commune with elemental forces, the departure of the natural wind spirits and the arrival of empty hollows signals a deep disturbance in the local balance of air.

faq.answer: The Windshapers are an order dedicated to understanding why the spirits of the wind abandoned them and discovering what can be done to bring those spirits back. Their investigations center on strange phenomena that emerged immediately after the spirits disappeared.

Hollows are a peculiar form of wind sprite that manifested in Shadowgale Forest only after the original wind spirits departed. Little is currently known about their origins or true nature, prompting scholars to gather their essences for further study.
Shadowgale Forest lies to the north. It is the region where the strange wind hollows have appeared in force, taking up residence following the withdrawal of the area's elemental spirits.

The exact reason the spirits of the wind vanished remains unknown. Uncovering the cause of their departure and finding a way to restore communion with them is the central purpose behind the Windshapers' research.
faq.q: Why did the wind spirits leave?

faq.answer: Wind Hollow Essences are collected from dispersed hollows so the Windshapers can examine their remains. By studying the physical essence left behind, they hope to discern what brought these beings into existence in the wake of the departed spirits.
faq.q: Why are Wind Hollow Essences being gathered?

faq.answer: While little is definitively understood about them, hollows are viewed as unwelcome intruders that appeared in the absence of the natural spirits. Their proliferation in Shadowgale Forest requires dispersal to protect the region and secure specimens.

sections.body: The Windshapers are consumed by a single, critical mystery: the sudden departure of the spirits of the wind. With communion severed, the order focuses all its efforts on discovering why the natural wind spirits abandoned them and determining what rituals or actions might entice them to return. In their absence, a void has been left in the local elemental atmosphere.
sections.title: The Vanished Spirits

sections.body: Following the departure of the wind spirits, an unsettling new presence emerged to the north in Shadowgale Forest. Observers began sighting strange wind sprites commonly referred to as hollows. Unknown to the Windshapers prior to the spirits' exodus, these beings seem closely tied to the sudden absence of the true air spirits. Dispersing them and retrieving their lingering essences offers the best chance of unraveling their nature.
sections.title: Shadows in Shadowgale

summary: Unwelcome Spirits is a task undertaken for the Windshapers to investigate the unsettling arrival of wind sprites known as 'hollows' in Shadowgale Forest. These strange entities only manifested after the true spirits of the wind departed, prompting the Windshapers to collect their essences to understand what drove the original spirits away.
